spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands region with extensive thick white cloud cover across the west, center and southeast. Patches of dark ocean are visible in the northeast and south-central. The islands including the large island near the southeast are largely obscured by clouds. No distinct gray haze, smoke or plume feature distinguishable from ordinary clouds is visible.

kilauea.activity_summary: Precursory low-level eruptive activity before episode 55 of the ongoing Halemaʻumaʻu eruption began around 15:45 p.m. HST on September 7, 2026.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts increased in August, while the summit region showed no other signs of deformation. Mauna Loa had an increase in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 87 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the August reporting period, after 57 in July. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
